messages:
jess: Heads up — a customer getting set up via the sample app accepted the invite, added a card, but their first API call just hangs and then returns 402. They say the UI shows ‘Welcome’ so they think they’re ready. Can someone sanity-check? :eyes:

sam: Do we have the curl or SDK call they made? Which SDK version?

jess: Node sample app, user ran `npm run start` from the template. Node SDK v0.9.1. Here's the curl they tried straight from the token they got via the app:```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/fast","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` Response: HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{"error":"billing_required","message":"Workspace billing not enabled"}

lee: Hmm billing_required but they just added a card? Could be async provisioning of the workspace. We queue the billing attach and the payment provider webhook sometimes lags ~30s. Did they retry? SDK auto-retries might be masking this \u2014 what was the client behavior?

jess: They saw the CLI spinner, then retried manually after ~10s. The app logs show three SDK retries in quick succession, then the user finally gets 200 on the 4th call ~45s later. They’re worried about being billed for the failed attempts and the UX where the sample app shows a greyed "Ready" state before provisioning is complete.

ash: @jess can you paste the sample app logs snippet? Need to confirm we return 402 consistently or sometimes vary 503/403. If it's always 402 we should short-circuit retries.

jess: Log snippet:```[2026-03-22T18:10:01.234Z] INFO starting request
[2026-03-22T18:10:01.567Z] ERROR api 402 {"error":"billing_required","message":"Workspace billing not enabled"}
[2026-03-22T18:10:01.768Z] INFO sdk retry 1
[2026-03-22T18:10:02.900Z] INFO sdk retry 2
[2026-03-22T18:10:04.122Z] INFO sdk retry 3
[2026-03-22T18:10:45.901Z] INFO api 200 {"id":"gen_abc123"}```

sam: That sequence makes sense. Two issues here: (1) sample app UI should show a clear "waiting for workspace provisioning" and not mark as Ready until webhook processed, (2) SDK should not do aggressive retries on 402 (billing_required) because retries only waste tokens and may confuse users.

lee: Agreed. I can add a quick check in the sample app to poll workspace.provisioning_state and surface a spinner + explanation. For the SDK, we should treat 402 and some 4xx as non-retriable by default. Current policy retries on network errors + 5xx. Looks like 402 is being considered retriable in v0.9.1 because our retry layer is too generic.

ash: Filing a small SDK patch: stop retries for status codes in [400..499] except 429. Also expose a config flag `retryOnClientError` for advanced users. Will target a patch for v0.9.2.

jess: Customer-facing note: I'll ping the user, explain provisioning might take ~30s, and confirm they won't be double-billed for transient 402s. Also linking runbook: https://intranet.redwood.ai/runbooks/onboard-provisioning-delay

ops-bot: Deployment: sample-app UI change pushed to staging by @lee at 18:45 UTC :rocket:

sam: Follow-ups: (1) @ash please add SDK test to assert no retry on 402, (2) @lee update sample app copy to mention "billing processing" state, (3) @jess confirm with customer and mark thread resolved.

ash: On it, will open PR and tag reviewers. ETA EOD.

jess: Thanks all — filing an internal postmortem entry in the onboarding board so PMs can consider smoother messaging. :thumbsup:
